exposure: fetal head station less than + 2 below the ischial spine
cohort: The study group included singleton pregnancies at >= 36 weeks' gestation undergoing a trial of vacuum birth at a single university-affiliated tertiary medical center between 2011-2023.
finding: Clinical chorioamnionitis was identified as the major independent risk factor for failed vacuum-assisted birth.
mod_finding: Clinical chorioamnionitis significantly increases the risk of failed vacuum-assisted birth, often leading to a switch to cesarean birth.
